name: an10-seo-skills
description: SEO and AI search (AEO/GEO) audits that end in a pull request, with each fix checked on the live site. Connect Agent Number 10 to see what the major AI assistants say about you, before and after.

interface.shortDescription: SEO and AEO audits with fixes
interface.longDescription: Agent skills for SEO and AI search (AEO/GEO). Audit a website's technical and on-page SEO, its structured data, images, internal links and readiness for AI assistants; make the fixes in your own code as a pull request; and check each fix on the live site. With an Agent Number 10 account it also reads what AI assistants answer about your brand, who they name instead, your Search Console data, keywords and local listings, and shows readings before and after a fix. For website owners, developers, SEO specialists and agencies. Limits: the page audits read public pages only; skills that use your own data providers need your own keys; AI answers and history need an Agent Number 10 account.
defaultPrompt: Run an SEO audit of my site and list what to fix first.
Check whether my site is ready for AI search.

positive.description: How often AI assistants name a tracked site
positive.prompt: How often do ChatGPT, Perplexity and the other AI assistants name notion.so in their answers?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the notion.so project, then gives the share of AI answers that name or cite notion.so, overall and per engine, from its latest measurement, with the date it was measured.

positive.prompt: Use Agent Number 10 to read notion.so's homepage and pricing page. How does Notion describe itself, and what plans does it sell?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads both pages through Agent Number 10 (a page the crawl did not cover is read live) and summarises how Notion describes itself and its plans with their prices.

positive.description: Site audit and what to fix first
positive.prompt: Audit notion.so's SEO and tell me what to fix first.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the open issues from the latest audit of notion.so, most important first, each with the affected page and the change that fixes it.

positive.prompt: What are notion.so's headline numbers in Agent Number 10?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the latest AEO score out of 100 and the AI visibility share of measured answers, each with the date it was measured.

positive.description: Keyword ideas with search volume, a live lookup that asks first
positive.prompt: Find keyword ideas around 'team wiki software' in the United States, with monthly search volume.
positive.expected_behavior: Says it will run one live lookup and asks to confirm before running it. After a yes, gives monthly search volume for the keyword and related terms.

negative.description: Creative writing is out of scope
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin is not used. The assistant answers on its own.

negative.description: Debugging code is out of scope
negative.prompt: Why does my Python script raise a TypeError when I add a number to a string?
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin is not used. The assistant answers on its own.

negative.prompt: What will the weather be in London tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin is not used. The assistant answers on its own or says it cannot check the weather.
